pattern_name: Gerunds and infinitives: advanced patterns and meaning change
pattern_name_ar: المصدر الاسمي والمصدر: أنماط متقدمة وتغيّر المعنى
formula: remember/forget/stop/go on/try + -ing vs to (meaning changes) · to have + participle (perfect infinitive) · to be + participle (passive infinitive) · not to / not -ing
formula_visual: [stop smoking] = quit // [stop to smoke] = pause in order to smoke
when_to_use: With some verbs the choice CHANGES THE MEANING: remember/forget + -ing = a memory; + to = a duty. stop + -ing = quit; + to = pause in order to. go on + -ing = continue; + to = move to a new topic. try + -ing = experiment; + to = attempt. Also: 'to have done' for an earlier action, 'to be done' for passive.
when_to_use_ar: مع بعض الأفعال يغيّر الاختيار المعنى: remember + -ing ذكرى و+ to واجب؛ stop + -ing يقلع و+ to يتوقف ليفعل؛ go on + -ing يستمر و+ to ينتقل.
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: At A2/B1 learners memorise which verbs take which form. At B2 that strategy breaks down, because BOTH forms are grammatical and the choice carries the meaning. Learners produce perfectly formed sentences that say the opposite of what they intended.

examples.en: He seems to have forgotten our meeting.

common_errors.wrong: He stopped to smoke last year. (meaning he quit)
common_errors.explanation: 'stop to smoke' means he paused in order to smoke — the opposite meaning.

common_errors.wrong: Remember locking the door tonight. (as an instruction)
common_errors.correct: Remember to lock the door tonight.
common_errors.explanation: A future duty takes 'to'; '-ing' refers to a past memory.

common_errors.wrong: He seems to forgot our meeting.
common_errors.correct: He seems to have forgotten our meeting.
common_errors.explanation: For an action earlier than the main verb, use the perfect infinitive.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: He stopped ___ (smoke) last year — he quit.
We stopped ___ (rest) halfway up the hill.
I remember ___ (lock) the door last night.

quick_rule: -ing looks BACK (memory, ongoing, quitting). 'to' looks FORWARD (duty, purpose, attempt). 'to have done' = earlier. 'to be done' = passive.
quick_rule_ar: -ing تنظر للخلف (ذكرى، استمرار، إقلاع). 'to' تنظر للأمام (واجب، غرض، محاولة). 'to have done' أقدم. 'to be done' مجهول.
mnemonic: -ing = backwards, 'to' = forwards. Check the meaning, not just the verb.
connect_to_speaking: In accent week 12 you drilled these pairs plus /təv/ for 'to have'. Say 'stop SMOKing' against 'stop tə REST' — if you pick the wrong form, you say the opposite of what you mean.
